title: Paul Barnes, his mutes, and pianist Lloyd Glenn
summary: Alcorn talks about trumpeter Paul Barnes, his mutes, and how Barnes left a job and Alcorn stayed on in his place. Alcorn also identifies pianist Lloyd Glenn and recalls recording with him in California.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
